newsitem.title: UK: Reuters shareholders suspend buyback vote.
newsitem.headline: Reuters shareholders suspend buyback vote.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said that shareholders had voted at a special meeting on Wednesday to adjourn motions on returning cash to shareholders via a share buyback.
"The resolutions were postponed indefinitely," a Reuters spokesman said.

The international news and information organisation asked shareholders to delay consideration of plans to return 613 million stg to shareholders via a share buyback and special bonus dividend issue after the British government on Tuesday abolished payment of tax credits for such schemes.
"A resolution for the company to enter CREST (share settlement system) was carried," the spokesman added.

The government's announcement on tax credits came just one day before Reuters shareholders were due to vote on proposals for the company's buyback scheme and prompted Reuters to ask shareholders to adjourn consideration of these plans.
Reuters said on Tuesday that given the uncertainty created by the government's statement it would be imprudent to proceed without further details and it would continue to review available options.
